description: Validates Kubernetes Ingress and Gateway API manifests for TLS enforcement, valid host declarations, backend resolution, and ingress class isolation

rules.description: k8s-ingress-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, declare name and a non-empty rules array. kind must be one of: Ingress, Gateway, HTTPRoute, GRPCRoute
Every rule must declare a hostname. Catch-all rules (no host) expose all traffic unconditionally. Duplicate hostnames across rules produce undefined routing behaviour
Every path rule must declare a non-empty path, a pathType from Prefix/Exact/ImplementationSpecific, and a backend with service name and port. Missing backends produce 502 errors
When TLS is configured: every TLS entry must have a secretName; every TLS host must have a matching rule. A TLS entry for a host with no rule means the certificate is served but requests return 404
All backend service names referenced in path rules must be declared in spec.backends. Undeclared backends create routing rules that point to nothing, producing silent 503 errors
k8s-ingress-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

Public-facing hosts (rules with a host field) must have TLS configured — serving HTTP without HTTPS exposes traffic to interception. ingressClass must be declared to prevent multiple controllers from managing the same resource
